description: Extract metadata from all HTTP Request packets in /home/ga/Documents/captures/http.cap and save them to a JSON file at /home/ga/Documents/captures/http_requests.json. You must identify only HTTP requests (exclude responses) and export the following fields: 'frame.number', 'frame.time_epoch', 'ip.src', 'http.host', 'http.request.method', and 'http.request.uri'. The output must be a valid JSON array.
